context: A countryside man and his aunt arrange a backyard gathering
purpose: Teach: 焼肉/百貨店/デッキ/蛙/水槽/ソフトウエア/小道具/浜松

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 叔母さん、今度の週末さ、うちの庭で焼肉パーティやろうと思ってるんだけど、来れる？
lines.en: Auntie, I'm thinking of having a yakiniku party in my yard this weekend. Can you come?
lines.style: Warm countryside-male tone, casual and inviting

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あら、いいわね。お肉はどうするの？浜松の駅前の百貨店でいいのが買えるわよ。
lines.en: Oh, lovely. What about the meat? You can get good cuts at the department store by Hamamatsu station.
lines.style: Cheerful middle-aged woman, helpful suggesting tone

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ああ、あそこの百貨店ね。じゃあ俺、明日浜松まで行ってくるよ。ウッドデッキも先週やっと完成したから、そこで焼こうかなって。
lines.en: Ah, that department store. Then I'll head out to Hamamatsu tomorrow. My wood deck was finally finished last week, so I thought we could grill there.
lines.style: Relaxed rural speech, slightly proud about the deck

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: デッキできたの？素敵じゃない。あ、そういえばあなた、玄関の水槽の蛙、まだ飼ってるの？
lines.en: The deck is done? How nice. Oh, by the way, are you still keeping that frog in the tank by the entrance?
lines.style: Curious aunt voice, shifting topic warmly and casually

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 蛙ね、元気だよ。水槽の掃除は面倒だけどさ。子供たちが来るなら見せたら喜ぶかな。
lines.en: The frog's doing great. Cleaning the tank is a pain though. The kids might enjoy seeing it if they come.
lines.style: Affectionate, easygoing country male delivery throughout

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 絶対喜ぶわよ。あと、うちの息子が今ソフトウエアの仕事で忙しいんだけど、当日は連れてくるつもり。
lines.en: They'll definitely love it. Also, my son is busy with software work right now, but I plan to bring him along that day.
lines.style: Proud-mother tone, conversational and bright, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: おお、久しぶりに会いたいな。あ、子供たち用に何か小道具っていうか、ゲームとか持ってきてくれる？
lines.en: Oh, I'd love to see him after so long. Hey, could you bring some props or games for the kids?
lines.style: Friendly countryside male, casual planning voice

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 任せて。花火とか虫取り網とか、ちょっとした小道具一式持ってくわね。楽しみだわ。
lines.en: Leave it to me. I'll bring fireworks, bug nets, a whole set of little props. I'm looking forward to it.
lines.style: Warm aunt tone, reassuring and excited
